name: Sharpness of the Cover-Recursive Position Bounds
statement: The cover-recursively peripheral class is a strict subclass both of the intersection of tree-like and proper semi-median partial cubes and of the intersection of tree-like, almost-median, ample, and corner-peelable partial cubes.
proof: Expand $Q_5$ peripherally along the pentagonal obstruction $\mathcal P_5$. The output is tree-like; the isometric ample site and cube base make it almost-median, ample, corner-peelable, and proper semi-median. Its copied site is a convex semicube isomorphic to $\mathcal P_5$. Convex heredity would force this obstruction into the cover-recursive class if the expanded graph belonged to it, so it witnesses both strict containments.
